ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.18.2-JT1 is a diagnostic build based exactly on the validated V0.4.18.2 aggressive playtest. No optimization or authority behavior is changed. The first JobGiver_Work.TryIssueJobPackage call taking at least 64 ms arms one bounded existing V0.4.8 detail-capture session on the following frame boundary. That temporary session records WorkGiver phases plus GenClosest, Reachability, RegionTraverser and scanner-source timings, then automatically removes all temporary detail patches. Butter++ and Adaptive TPS should remain disabled for comparison.
